ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; the surface is predominantly dark (black) with sparse, high-contrast white speckling and linear marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-tone contiguous mass across both lobes. Mapping reveals localized high-intensity pixel clusters (dots) throughout and a distinct, large curvilinear white stroke in the lower-central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 45-55 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately one-third the vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge consisting of jagged triangular peaks and valleys with varying amplitudes (approx. 5-20 pixels).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the outer edges of both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast white clusters (1-5 pixels in diameter) distributed semi-randomly across both lobes, characteristic of barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible, including diagonal streaks on the upper left lobe and a prominent curved mark on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a prominent, high-intensity white curvilinear mark on the lower right lobe and various linear abrasions across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, large 'U-shaped' white linear mark located near the central notch on the right lobe.
